When applying a CW-roll motion: Set1, 3 are set to be one higher than the other (i.e. ωm1 < ωm3) while Set2, 4 has similar configurations (i.e. ωm2 > ωm4) as shown in Fig. 6c. A CCW-Roll angle is achieved by setting ωm1 > ωm3 in Set1, 3 while setting the speeds of Set2, 4 to ωm2 < ωm4. Finally, a CW-Yaw rotation around the z-axis is accomplished by up- holding an equivalent speed of Set1, 3 while reducing speed in Set2, 4.
